sampling: successive Random(seed).choice, remove selected, preserve first draw
funding_reserve: maximum absolute settled rate in prior 72h * ceil(maximum holding hours / 8); no future funding used for sizing
funding_exit: at each completed decision bar, exit if sunk adverse funding plus remaining-horizon estimate and round-trip execution friction exceeds 20% of initial stop distance
stock_atr: Wilder ATR14 of continuous contract 15m bars, including overnight; 2-day warmup
crypto_trailing: activate on completed 1h close >= 2R; use post-entry completed 1h extrema and ATR; effective after close only
stock_exits: initial stop or 15:45 America/New_York; no unspecified profit target or trailing added
stock_signal: each qualifying completed 15m close after 10:00 and before 14:30; VWAP=sum(quote volume)/sum(base volume) since 09:30
rule_history: current public exchangeInfo assumed unchanged except BTC min notional 100 before 2026-04-14T06:30Z, 50 afterwards; historical step sizes/ETH minimum not independently certified
